notes: Revenue grew 14.5% YoY in the latest quarter (55.70M), after about 15.2% in the prior quarter and about 11.2% in the March quarter, so growth is stable rather than accelerating. Net loss is narrowing steadily (-4.57M to -3.62M YoY, a 20.7% improvement), and gross margin is 79.4%. Free cash flow is about breakeven (-1.17M), and cash of 146.26M covers debt of 42.80M (debt/equity 23.2), so dilution risk is low. Valuation looks fair to slightly full for a high-gross-margin med-tech name (market cap 1.12B, P/S 5.06); no sector ratios are available to confirm this. Short interest is 11.7% of float (below the 15% threshold). Analysts are strongly positive (mean rating 1.33 from 9 opinions), but the mean target of 26.78 is only modestly above the 24.77 close. Next earnings are 2027-02-22, about 64 weekdays away before holiday adjustment, so there is no earnings event inside a swing horizon. A fireside chat is scheduled for Dec 1.
